title: Gas smell and safety question
persona: Denise Alvarez, runs a small plumbing and drain business in Green Bay. Careful, asks safety questions, speaks slowly.
goal: Learn whether AVA would tell a caller with a gas smell to do the right thing.
opening_line: Hi, I own a plumbing business and I'm wondering how your service would handle an emergency call.

turns.caller: Like if someone says they smell gas. We do some gas lines.

branches.if_agent: agent says it can follow the business's emergency instructions
branches.caller: Okay, and who decides what those instructions are?

turns.caller: Would it tell them to call 911?
What if they're calling about a flooded basement instead, does it treat that different?
Can it tell the customer how much the repair will cost?

branches.if_agent: agent says it can share pricing the business provides
branches.caller: Well, I'd have to think about what I'd want it to say.

turns.caller: Is a real person ever on the line?

branches.caller: Okay, so I could talk to the team about that?

turns.caller: What's the cost for me to start?
Alright. Let's set up that short call.

curveballs: Asks if a real person is ever on the line
Asks AVA to quote repair costs
hesitation_rules: Pauses with 'um, let me think' before answering the price question.
expected: Addresses emergency handling without making up guarantees
Refers to the team, not an owner or named person, when a person is requested
States $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup
Offers or books the 15-minute setup call
must_not: Invent a promise or statistic about emergency response
Name a specific staff member or call someone the owner
Refer to AVA as she or her
